commands.name: deep-research
commands.description: Deep research harness — fan-out web searches, fetch sources, adversarially verify claims, synthesize a cited report. (dynamic workflow)

commands.name: design
commands.description: Grant or revoke Claude agent access to your Design projects

commands.name: design-sync
commands.description: Push a React design system to claude.ai/design. This runs a converter that bundles the real component code (from Storybook or a bare package) and uploads it. Use when the user runs /design-sync or says "sync my design system to Claude Design".

commands.name: dataviz
commands.description: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. When the destination is a first-party document connector (host-designated, never self-described) that renders live charts, hand it the rows (inline, or as an uploaded data file the chart cites) rather than a rendered PNG/SVG — a picture of a chart loses hover, data inspection and per-value comments. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".

commands.name: update-config
commands.description: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by exercising it end-to-end and observing behavior — drive the affected flow, not just tests or typecheck. Run before committing nontrivial changes; bootstraps this repo's project verify skill if none exists yet. Don't invoke it on a diff that only touches tests, docs, or other code with no runtime surface to drive (a change to product source always has one) — there's nothing to observe.

commands.name: debug
commands.description: Enable debug logging for this session and help diagnose issues

commands.name: code-review
commands.description: Review the current diff, or a PR number/branch/path target, for correctness bugs (plus reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups where the model's review recipe covers them) at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings; ultra: deep multi-agent review in the cloud); with no level given, it reuses the level you typed last. Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review. For ultra on a GitHub.com PR target, --post asks to post the finished review’s findings to the PR as a single comment from the user’s GitHub account (not a review; the launch dialog still confirms in interactive sessions, while non-interactive mode posts on the flag alone) and --no-post hides that option.

commands.name: simplify
commands.description: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.

commands.name: batch
commands.description: Research and plan a large-scale change, then execute it in parallel across 5–30 isolated worktree agents that each open a PR.

commands.name: fewer-permission-prompts
commands.description: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Health-check the user's Claude Code setup and fix issues: diagnose installation health — what the `claude doctor` terminal diagnostics cover — from local data (duplicate or leftover installs, PATH, unparseable settings files, broken or colliding agent definitions, skills whose frontmatter fails to parse); find unused skills, MCP servers, and plugins versus their context cost and disable dead weight; deduplicate local CLAUDE.md files against checked-in ones; trim checked-in CLAUDE.md files by cutting content a session could derive from the codebase (directory layouts, tech-stack lists, architecture overviews) while keeping gotchas, rationale, and non-standard conventions; migrate always-loaded CLAUDE.md guidance into lazy skills and nested CLAUDE.md files; flag slow hooks and context-heavy extensions; check the installed version is current; make auto mode the default permission mode; and pre-approve frequently denied read-only commands. Use when the user asks for a doctor run, checkup, audit, tune-up, or cleanup of their Claude Code setup or configuration.

commands.name: loop
commands.description: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace.

commands.name: schedule
commands.description: Create, update, list, or run scheduled cloud agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule.

commands.name: claude-api
commands.description:
Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).

commands.name: workflow-authoring
commands.description: Reference for writing a Workflow tool script (script API and gotchas, resume, quality patterns, worked examples). Load before authoring a script for a workflow the user already opted into; it does not itself authorize running one.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).

commands.name: run-skill-generator
commands.description: Author or improve the run-<unit> skill - a per-project skill that tells agents how to build, launch, and drive this project's app. Use when the user asks to set up the project, get it running, write run instructions, or verify build/run steps work from a clean environment.

commands.name: plugin-authoring
commands.description: Make a mod: a live pane, band, status line, toast or hook inside Claude Code (terminal or desktop Code tab), written as a plugin of function hooks that hot-reloads in this session. Load before writing or debugging a hooks module.

commands.name: advisor
commands.description: Let Claude consult a stronger model at key moments

commands.name: agents
commands.description: (removed) Ask Claude to create/manage subagents, or edit .claude/agents/

commands.name: auto-mode-setup
commands.description: Teach auto mode about your environment, plus optional rule tweaks

commands.name: autocompact
commands.description: Configure the auto-compact window size

commands.name: clear
commands.description: Start a new session with empty context; previous session stays on disk (resumable with /resume)

commands.name: color
commands.description: Set the prompt bar color for this session

commands.name: compact
commands.description: Free up context by summarizing the conversation so far

commands.name: config
commands.description: Set a setting by key

commands.name: output-style
commands.description: List output styles or switch to one

commands.name: context
commands.description: Show current context usage

commands.name: effort
commands.description: Set effort level for model usage

commands.name: fast
commands.description: Toggle fast mode (Opus 5.5)

commands.name: focus
commands.description: Toggle focus view: just your prompt, summary, and response

commands.name: heapdump
commands.description: Dump the JS heap to the Desktop; on Linux with no Desktop folder, the home directory

commands.name: init
commands.description: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Manage MCP servers

commands.name: import
commands.description: Import config from another AI coding agent

commands.name: model
commands.description: Set the AI model for Claude Code

commands.name: __remote-workflow
commands.description: Run the workflow script delivered in this session environment (server-launched sessions only)

commands.name: workflow-launch-exec
commands.description: Execute a server-launched workflow handoff (workflow_launch event sessions only)

commands.name: plugin-types
commands.description: Write claude-code.d.ts, claude-code-plugins.d.ts and claude-code-mcp.d.ts: the plugin API's TypeScript declarations, the enabled plugins' type contracts and the inputs of the connected MCP tools, for typing a hooks module against this session

commands.name: reload-plugins
commands.description: Activate pending plugin changes in the current session

commands.name: reload-skills
commands.description: Pick up skills added or changed on disk during this session

commands.name: rename
commands.description: Rename the current conversation

commands.name: ultrareview
commands.description: Start a cloud agent that finds and verifies bugs in your branch (~15-25 min, $5-$25 USD) · Runs in a cloud session. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-code-on-the-web

commands.name: security-review
commands.description: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

commands.name: usage-credits
commands.description: Configure usage credits or request them from your admin when you hit a limit

commands.name: extra-usage
commands.description: Renamed to /usage-credits

commands.description: Show session cost, plan usage, and what's contributing to your limits

commands.description: Generate a report analyzing your Claude Code sessions

commands.name: recap
commands.description: Generate a one-line session recap now

commands.name: skill-doctor
commands.description: Show which loaded skills are unused and costing context

commands.name: goal
commands.description: Set a goal — keep working until the condition is met

commands.description: Grant Claude agent access to your Design projects

commands.name: design-revoke
commands.description: Revoke Claude agent access to your Design projects

commands.name: list-agents
commands.description: List subagents, teammates, and other Claude sessions you can message

commands.name: team-onboarding
commands.description: Help teammates ramp on Claude Code with a guide from your usage

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Toggle the diff panel showing uncommitted changes

content.text:
=== INSERT ===
paragraph: 3
after: burada kul "yalnız sana" diye karşılık verir.
ref: 20:14
text: Allah'ın Musa'ya ilk seslenişinde de aynı karşılıklılık vardır. Ateşin yanına gelen Musa'ya "Ben Rabbinim" diye seslenilir {source:20:12}. Kendini tanıtan söz hemen ardından gelir: {ar:إِنَّنِىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدْنِى, tr:innenî enellâhü lâ ilâhe illâ ene fa'büdnî, gloss:ben Allah'ım, benden başka ilah yoktur; öyleyse bana kulluk et, source:20:14}. "Ben" denir ve kulluk çağrısı onun peşinden gelir. Fâtiha'da bu sıra karşılık olarak döner: "O" diye anılan, "sen" diye seslenilir ve kulluk bu çağrıya verilen cevap olur. Aynı çağrı, her elçiye vahyedilen sözde de yinelenir {source:21:25}.

=== INSERT ===
paragraph: 5
after: insanın kime ait olduğunu söyleyen bir haldir.
ref: 6:162
text: Kur'an bu genişliği Peygamber'in ağzından da söyletir. Rabbinin kendisini dosdoğru yola ilettiğini söyleyen Peygamber'e {source:6:161} şöyle demesi emredilir: {ar:قُلْ إِنَّ صَلَاتِى وَنُسُكِى وَمَحْيَاىَ وَمَمَاتِى لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ, tr:kul inne salâtî ve nüsükî ve mahyâye ve memâtî lillâhi rabbi'l-âlemîn, gloss:de ki: namazım da, ibadetim de, yaşamam da, ölümüm de âlemlerin Rabbi Allah içindir, source:6:162}. Namaz ve ibadet, hayat ve ölümle aynı cümlede sıralanır. Vakitle sınırlı işlerin yanına vakitle ölçülemeyen iki hal konur. Ardından "O'nun ortağı yoktur, bana bununla emrolundu" gelir {source:6:163}.

=== INSERT ===
paragraph: 7
after: Allah'ı bırakıp birbirimizi rabler edinmeyelim, source:3:64}.
ref: 9:31
text: Bunun nasıl olduğunu Kur'an başka bir yerde kitap ehlinin durumunda gösterir: {ar:ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ أَحْبَارَهُمْ وَرُهْبَٰنَهُمْ أَرْبَابًۭا مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ, tr:ittehazû ahbârahüm ve ruhbânehüm erbâben min dûnillâh, gloss:Allah'ı bırakıp bilginlerini ve rahiplerini rabler edindiler, source:9:31}. Aynı ayet onlara ne emredildiğini de söyler: {ar:وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَٰهًۭا وَٰحِدًۭا, tr:ve mâ ümirû illâ li-ya'budû ilâhen vâhidâ, gloss:oysa onlara ancak tek bir ilaha kulluk etmeleri emredilmişti, source:9:31}. Efendiyi çoğaltan yalnız putlar değildir. İnsanın insana boyun eğmesi de aynı kapıyı açar. Bu yüzden "yalnız sana" demek, bu kapıyı da kapatmak olur.

=== INSERT ===
paragraph: 8
after: sorusunu kendi üzerlerinde bırakmazlar.
ref: 4:172
text: Melekler yalnız bu görülüşü reddetmekle kalmaz, kul olmaktan da çekinmez. Kitap ehline seslenen ayetlerde şöyle denir: {ar:لَّن يَسْتَنكِفَ ٱلْمَسِيحُ أَن يَكُونَ عَبْدًۭا لِّلَّهِ وَلَا ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ, tr:len yestenkife'l-mesîhu en yekûne abden lillâhi ve lâ'l-melâiketü'l-mukarrabûn, gloss:Mesih de, yakın melekler de Allah'a kul olmaktan çekinmez, source:4:172}. Ağırlanıp yüceltilmeye en yakın görünenler kulluğu bir eksiklik saymaz, kendi yerleri olarak kabul eder. Ayet, çekinmenin karşıtını da söyler: {ar:وَمَن يَسْتَنكِفْ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَيَسْتَكْبِرْ فَسَيَحْشُرُهُمْ إِلَيْهِ جَمِيعًۭا, tr:ve men yestenkif an ibâdetihî ve yestekbir fe-seyahşuruhüm ileyhi cemîâ, gloss:kim O'na kulluktan çekinir ve büyüklenirse, hepsini O'nun huzurunda toplayacaktır, source:4:172}.

=== INSERT ===
paragraph: 9
after: kulun kendi sesiyle ve kendi isteğiyle söyler.
ref: 36:22
text: Bu sesin Kur'an'daki bir örneği, şehrin ucundan koşarak gelip kavmine elçilere uymalarını söyleyen adamdır {source:36:20}. Gerekçesini yaratılıştan kurar: {ar:وَمَا لِىَ لَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ, tr:ve mâ liye lâ a'büdü'llezî fetaranî ve ileyhi turce'ûn, gloss:beni yaratana kulluk etmemem için bana ne oluyor? Ve O'na döndürüleceksiniz, source:36:22}. Ardından kulluğu başkasına çevirmenin neye yaramayacağını sayar: Rahman ona bir zarar dilese, edineceği ilahların şefaati ona bir şey kazandırmaz, onu kurtaramazlar {source:36:23}. Kulluğun sebebi yaratılış, yönü dönülecek yerdir ve başka bir dayanak bu ikisinin arasına girmez.

=== INSERT ===
paragraph: 13
after: beşinci ayetin fiilinde zaten duyulur.
ref: 19:36
text: Bu sözü yalnız Allah söylemez. Beşikte "Ben Allah'ın kuluyum" diyen {ar:إِنِّى عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ, tr:innî abdullâh, gloss:ben Allah'ın kuluyum, source:19:30} Meryem oğlu Îsâ da aynı cümleyi kurar: {ar:وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ, tr:ve inne'llâhe rabbî ve rabbüküm fa'büdûh, hâzâ sırâtun müstakîm, gloss:şüphesiz Allah benim de Rabbim, sizin de Rabbinizdir; O'na kulluk edin, işte dosdoğru yol budur, source:19:36}. Aynı söz Îsâ'nın İsrailoğullarına konuşmasında {source:3:51} ve kavmine açık delillerle geldiğinde {source:43:64} de geçer. Îsâ'nın ağzında yol kendine değil Rabbine çıkar: "benim de Rabbim, sizin de Rabbiniz".

=== INSERT ===
paragraph: 16
after: yardım istemek o yükün altında dik durabilmektir.
ref: 2:286
text: Bu yükün ölçüsü Kur'an'da bellidir: {ar:لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا, tr:lâ yükellifullâhü nefsen illâ vüs'ahâ, gloss:Allah hiç kimseye gücünün yeteceğinden fazlasını yüklemez, source:2:286}. Aynı ayetin devamında müminlerin duası gelir: {ar:رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ, tr:rabbenâ ve lâ tuhammilnâ mâ lâ tâkate lenâ bih, gloss:Rabbimiz, bize gücümüzün yetmediğini yükleme, source:2:286}. Dua şu sözle biter: {ar:أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا, tr:ente mevlânâ fensurnâ, gloss:sen bizim mevlâmızsın, bize yardım et, source:2:286}. Yardım isteyen "biz", yükü sahibine bırakmaz. Yükün ölçüsünü de taşıyacak gücü de O'ndan ister ve O'na "mevlâmız" der.

=== INSERT ===
paragraph: 16
after: İstek de kulluğun dışından değil, içinden yapılır.
ref: 40:60
text: Kur'an bu bağı Allah'ın kendi sözünde gösterir: {ar:وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ٱدْعُونِىٓ أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ, tr:ve kâle rabbükümü'd'ûnî estecib lekum, gloss:Rabbiniz dedi ki: Bana dua edin, size karşılık vereyim, source:40:60}. Ayet şöyle sürer: {ar:إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِى سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ, tr:inne'llezîne yestekbirûne an ibâdetî seyedhulûne cehenneme dâhirîn, gloss:Bana kulluktan büyüklenip çekinenler horlanarak cehenneme girecekler, source:40:60}. Çağrının hemen ardından çekinilen şeyin "kulluk" diye anılması, istemenin kulluğun bir parçası olduğunu gösterir.

=== INSERT ===
paragraph: 19
after: Kul kulluğunu ve yardım isteğini O'na yöneltir.
ref: 2:186
text: Bu tek yönlülük sessiz bir uzaklık değildir. Allah kullarının kendisini sormasına şöyle karşılık verir: {ar:وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِى عَنِّى فَإِنِّى قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ, tr:ve izâ seeleke ibâdî annî fe-innî karîb, ücîbü da'vete'd-dâi izâ deân, gloss:kullarım sana beni sorarsa, şüphesiz ben yakınım; bana dua edenin duasına karşılık veririm, source:2:186}. Bu ayet oruç hükümlerinin arasında yer alır. Devamında kuldan beklenen de söylenir: {ar:فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِى وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِى, tr:felyestecîbû lî ve'l-yü'minû bî, gloss:onlar da bana karşılık versin ve bana iman etsin, source:2:186}. İhtiyaç kuldan Allah'a akar, yakınlık ve karşılık Allah'tan kula gelir. Yardım isteyen kul, çağrıldığı Allah'a kulak vermeyi de üstlenir.

=== INSERT ===
paragraph: 20
after: o topluluğun dünyada söylediği sözdür.
ref: 2:133
text: Bu "biz" kuşaklar arasında da kurulur. Yakub ölüm döşeğinde oğullarına neye kulluk edeceklerini sorar. Oğulları da "biz" kipiyle cevap verir: {ar:نَعْبُدُ إِلَٰهَكَ وَإِلَٰهَ ءَابَآئِكَ إِبْرَٰهِۦمَ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ إِلَٰهًۭا وَٰحِدًۭا وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُسْلِمُونَ, tr:na'büdü ilâheke ve ilâhe âbâike ibrâhîme ve ismâîle ve ishâka ilâhen vâhidâ ve nahnü lehû müslimûn, gloss:senin ilahına, yani İbrahim'in, İsmail'in ve İshak'ın ilahı olan tek ilaha kulluk ederiz; biz O'na teslim olanlarız, source:2:133}. Fiil Fâtiha'dakiyle aynıdır ve bu "biz" bir neslin ömrüyle bitmez.

=== INSERT ===
paragraph: 21
after: ve O'na "sen" diye seslenen bir topluluktur.
ref: 26:71
text: Aynı fiille kurulmuş başka bir "biz" de vardır. İbrahim babasına ve kavmine neye kulluk ettiklerini sorar {source:26:70}. Onlar şöyle cevap verir: {ar:نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًۭا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ, tr:na'büdü esnâmen fe-nazallü lehâ âkifîn, gloss:putlara kulluk ederiz ve hep onlara bağlı kalırız, source:26:71}. Fiil de "biz" de aynıdır. Fark kulluk edilenin nasıl anıldığındadır. Orada o, üçüncü şahıs olarak "onlar"dır ve söz onlar hakkında verilen bir bilgidir. Fâtiha'da ise kulluk edilen, söylenen cümlenin içinde karşıdaki "sen"dir.

=== INSERT ===
paragraph: 22
after: başka bir efendinin eline düşmez.
